objective: Provide custom React Query hooks useSystemHealthSummary and useCycleTimeline for system health summary data and cycle event timelines.

acceptance.criterion: useSystemHealthSummary fetches system health summary counts from /devices/{deviceId}/health-summary and remains disabled when deviceId is empty.
useCycleTimeline fetches cycle timeline events from /devices/{deviceId}/events/cycle/{cycleId} and remains disabled when cycleId is null.
Frontend quality gates pass (tsc, eslint --max-warnings=0, vitest, npm run build) with zero errors or warnings.
acceptance.verification: Execution of npm test, npm run lint, and npm run build in hydragrow-frontend
